    • candidates

      public <T> List<CameraAimAssistTargeting.Candidate<T>> candidates(T identity, List<CameraRaycast.Box> subHitboxes, List<CameraRaycast.Box> pickingBoxes, CameraRaycast.Box fallback, int existingCount, float scale)
      Sub-hitboxes replace generic picking boxes; nonempty lists suppress fallback even when none qualify. Native checks the 101-candidate threshold once per actor, so one actor can append multiple boxes at 100. Actor exclusions and obstruction must be resolved by the caller.
